correctness.rationale: Reconstructed modular proof: for even k, Cassini and u=F_{k+2},v=F_{k+1},a=F_k imply m=gcd(u³−1,v³−1)|u−1 and m=gcd(u−1,3(v−1)); modulo m, δ=v−1 satisfies 3δ=δ²=0, hence every cubic shift difference vanishes and its exact common gcd is m. The first-window identity 4S0=v³+a³−3(v−a)+2 gives m|4S0; Fibonacci parity and valuation at k≡0 (mod6) produce precisely one factor 2 loss, otherwise m odd. Independently checked even k=2..180: m formula and 12 consecutive exact integer window gcds all agree. Those finite checks supplement, not replace, the all-k Cassini/valuation proof.
